topic: What if Franky had kept Tom's Pluton blueprints instead of burning them at Enies Lobby, and how that collides with Treasure Tree Adam on Elbaf
title: What If Franky Kept The Pluton Blueprints?
description:
What if Franky never burned the Pluton blueprints at Enies Lobby? Following Tom's duty from Water 7 through Karakuri Island and Wano to Treasure Tree Adam on Elbaf, this story shows why that one match may be the reason Franky can still stand under Roger's tree.

Would you have burned the plans or kept them? Part of our What If series, right after the Ace survival story.
